tools.name: set_brand_kit

tools.description: [Free] Partial update of the options every film starts from (below a site's brand kit). null clears a field.

tools.name: list_options

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: [Free] Removes a member or cancels an invite, freeing the seat; your own member id leaves the workspace. Their work stays.

tools.name: create_review_link

tools.name: request_approval

tools.name: request_changes

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: [Free] Adds a timestamped comment; open comments feed the editor's AI revision.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: [Free] Who did what here, newest first: members, spending, review links, approvals, comments.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: [Free] Sets (or with null clears) the account-wide URL that receives a signed JSON event whenever a render ends. The first time a secret is needed it is created and returned here, once.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: [Free] Replaces the secret completion events are signed with and returns the new one, once. The old secret stops verifying at once, including for retries still in flight.

tools.name: delete_character

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_video_embed, list_videos, run_show, list_commons_assets, list_assets, list_connections, get_frames, list_comments, add_comment, get_audit_log · Private data: get_video, detect_brand, rerender_video, create_format, validate_format, verify_episode, register_mcp_connection, list_assets, list_connections, create_motion, get_motion_template, get_motion_grammar, save_motion_spec, upload_asset, create_upload, set_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: create_show, register_mcp_connection, upload_asset, create_upload, list_members, set_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Destructive: run_show, update_show, create_format, update_format, get_format, fork_format, validate_format, preview_episode, verify_episode, register_mcp_connection, delete_object, validate_motion_spec, remove_member, delete_character.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_video_embed, list_videos, run_show, list_commons_assets, list_assets, list_connections, get_frames, list_comments, add_comment, get_audit_log · Private data: get_video, detect_brand, rerender_video, create_format, validate_format, verify_episode, register_mcp_connection, list_assets, list_connections, create_motion, get_motion_template, get_motion_grammar, save_motion_spec, upload_asset, create_upload, set_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: create_show, register_mcp_connection, upload_asset, create_upload, list_members, set_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Destructive: run_show, update_show, create_format, update_format, get_format, fork_format, validate_format, preview_episode, verify_episode, register_mcp_connection, delete_object, validate_motion_spec, remove_member, delete_character

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
